svg.title: Ultima humanoid rig
svg.desc: Neutral pose of the default 1.75 metre player. Front and side projections show parent connections and primary pivots. Insets show every finger and toe on the right side.
svg.text: Neutral pose · default 1.75 m player · 73 joint pivots plus the actor root
Z / Y projection · left and right overlap
Pelvis and upper-body pivots coincide at Y = 0.77 m. Detail views separate joints that overlap in the full projections.
